premises.text: Mobile email UIs still expose cluttered formats, metadata, and repeating signatures unlike messaging
premises.evidence_span: when you scroll down this email, you will need to go through all these frustrating formats, annoying metadata, and repeating signatures again and again

premises.text: Intelligent parsing reformats inbox into chat-like conversation bubbles with optional original view
premises.evidence_span: MailTime's intelligent content parsing engine can reformat all your emails into this conversation view so that you can mail like what you do, like text messaging

premises.text: In-thread @mentions, task lists, and group-chat-like participant management turn email into actionable teamwork
premises.evidence_span: you can also mention someone with an at symbol to assign a task

premises.text: Length warnings nudge users to keep emails short enough to read
premises.evidence_span: when I'm trying to send this super long email, Mailtime just told me that it's too long, didn't read

premises.text: Mail syncs directly with the user's mail server without cloud content storage; freemium charges $0.99 for extra accounts
premises.evidence_span: we send and receive every single email just directly between your mail server and Mailtime on your phone. So we don't touch any content

value.text: Make smartphone email as easy as text messaging without desktop clutter
value.evidence_span: It's a way how we design email for your smartphone

causal_links.evidence_span: email is the most important thing on your smartphone
you can mail like what you do, like text messaging

notes: Format/metadata/signature clutter folded as one mobile-email pain. Conversation view + tasks/@mentions + length nudge treated as related product capabilities that could fail separately (split per tie-break). Security path and freemium pricing packaged as commercial/trust condition. TalkBox growth numbers excluded as biography/traction. Time-limited promo excluded.
